name: Grand Mercure Solo Baru
short_description: A 345-room hotel in Solo Baru's central business district, with a 21st-floor sky lounge, a 3rd-floor infinity pool, and direct access to The Park Mall.
ai_summary: Grand Mercure Solo Baru sits in the central business district of Solo Baru, rebranding into the Grand Mercure name in October 2022 after operating as Best Western Premier Solo Baru. The 345 rooms and suites offer city skyline views, complemented by a sky lounge on the 21st floor and an infinity pool on the 3rd floor, with direct access to The Park Mall and walking distance to the Hartono Trade Center and Pakuwon Mall. Guests consistently describe the hotel as good value, citing spacious rooms, quality pool and sauna facilities, and strong food and beverage offerings.

faqs.question: Was Grand Mercure Solo Baru previously a different brand?
faqs.answer: Yes -- it operated as Best Western Premier Solo Baru before rebranding into the Grand Mercure name in October 2022, becoming part of Accor's ALL - Accor Live Limitless program.

faqs.question: Does Grand Mercure Solo Baru have a rooftop lounge?
faqs.answer: Yes -- a sky lounge on the 21st floor offers city skyline views, alongside an infinity pool on the 3rd floor and direct access to The Park Mall.
